name: Sixty Three Clinton

menus.name: Seven-course seasonal tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu, served in the dining room, the bar room and at the kitchen counter; caviar hand roll $55 extra

bookingOpens: Online on Resy. Tables open 21 days ahead at midnight New York time. Dinner Tuesday to Saturday from 6pm.
cancellation: Cancel by 5pm two days before the booking; after that the fee is $130 per person. Tables are held for 20 minutes for late arrivals.
walkIns: No walk-ins for dinner; reservation only. The 10-seat bar room, with six counter seats facing the kitchen, serves the same tasting menu.
groups: Resy takes parties of up to six; parties of six or more pay a 20% service charge.
byob: Corkage is $75 per 750ml bottle, waived if a bottle is bought from the wine list.
